name: Blur
author: Vestra Player
punchline: A live Gaussian blur over the video that is playing
description:
Turn a Gaussian blur on and off from Video ▸ Blur or with Ctrl+Shift+B, and adjust its strength in the Blur window while the video plays. The strength is remembered; Options ▸ Video ▸ Blur decides whether blur comes back on at startup.
This is the Vestra Player SDK's flagship example: commands, a tool window, a settings page, on-screen messages, a video filter and plugin storage.
